body.name: Random-phase affine Boolean Golay-block law
body.construction: Let \(L=2^p\). In each block draw \(\alpha\in\mathbb F_2^p\) and \(\sigma\in\{-1,+1\}\) uniformly and independently, set \(\phi_L(j)=\sum_{r=0}^{p-2}j_rj_{r+1}\pmod 2\) for the binary digits \((j_0,\ldots,j_{p-1})\) of \(j\), and set \(W_j=\sigma(-1)^{\phi_L(j)+\sum_{r=0}^{p-1}\alpha_rj_r}\). Concatenate independent blocks in both directions and shift the origin by an independent uniform phase in \(\{0,\ldots,L-1\}\); the resulting law is \(D_L^{\mathrm G}\).
